title: Prehistoric Revival
description: This mod is an add-on for Unusual Prehistory 2 that allows the dinosaurs you have revived to spawn naturally in the world! The mod will be updated alongside updates to the main Unusual Prehistory 2 mod.
body: Here, I’ll explain how the mod works. You follow the same steps as in the standard mod, but with one difference: the task of reviving dinosaurs now rests on your shoulders. Once a species appears, a message will pop up in the chat: "You have revived the ... species; it will now spawn naturally in the world!", and you need to be near 46 block's to earn the massege.
